data.body: **[P2] Track ambiguous invocations before allowing function reuse.** If Lambda accepts an invocation but its response is lost, this path raises before registering it in `self.invocations`. Per-case teardown cannot discover or stop that execution and skips settlement polling when no other invocations exist. Final run collection happens too late to prevent subsequent cases from reusing an occupied function. Register the marker before invoking, recover matching execution ARNs during teardown, and block reuse until settlement is established. Add a lost-response teardown test.
